entrance.title: Entrance
entrance.summary: Main entrance to Hall C1. Registration check and bag check happen here.

items.heading: Before you enter
items.body: Have your Simaster confirmation or QR ready. Security checks bags at the door.

items.heading: Just inside
items.body: The Information Center is on the left; the Career Expo floor starts ahead.

entrance.tip: Queues peak at 09.00 — arrive 15 minutes early.

registration.title: Registration
registration.summary: Verify your registration and collect your visitor pass.

items.heading: What to show
items.body: Simaster QR for UGM students, or the mitra confirmation email for non-UGM visitors.

items.heading: Other desks
items.body: Walk-in interviews register at Hall B; this desk is for event entry.

registration.tip: Keep your pass visible for re-entry.

photobooth.title: Photobooth
photobooth.summary: Photo booth for the event — take a shot, print it, or share it.

items.heading: What's here
items.body: The booth setup, props and the official frame.

photobooth.tip: Tag the official account so we can repost.

photo-wall.title: Photo Wall
photo-wall.summary: The event photo wall — tag the official account to be featured.

items.heading: Lighting
items.body: Best light is from the entrance side; avoid shooting into the hall.

photo-wall.tip: Tag the official account so we can repost.

panggung.title: Panggung
panggung.summary: Main stage — talks, announcements and scheduled programme moments.

items.heading: What happens here
items.body: Opening, company talks, announcements and closing.

items.heading: Best time
items.body: Check the live card; programme moments are short and scheduled.

panggung.tip: Seating is first come, first served.

toilet.title: Toilet
toilet.summary: Toilet and accessible washroom inside Hall C1.

items.heading: Location
items.body: Follow the toilet glyphs on the plan; the nearest block is beside the Mushola.

items.heading: Accessibility
items.body: An accessible cubicle is available in the same block.

toilet.tip: Please keep the area clean for the next visitor.

mushola.title: Mushola

items.heading: Location
items.body: Next to the toilet block, marked with the crescent on the plan.

items.heading: Etiquette
items.body: Please remove shoes before entering and keep voices low.

mushola.tip: Wudhu facilities are available beside the room.

pusat-bantuan.title: Pusat Bantuan
pusat-bantuan.summary: Help Desk for directions, lost items and event questions.

items.heading: What we handle
items.body: Wayfinding, lost and found, accessibility requests and general event info.

items.heading: Find us
items.body: Look for the committee members in pink vests near the Information Center.

pusat-bantuan.tip: Ask any committee member if the desk is unattended.
